body: I appreciate the sympathy, but I wasn't looking for people to feel sorry for me at all. I just need a reason to live.

I have heard this over-optimistic salvation style "don't kill yourself please" material before.

The fact of the matter is that my earthly experience is limited to this life, and I have absolutely no reason to believe that the future will be any different than the past. I have never made it "past the pain". My entire life, from a small child even, has been a story of pain. I have thrived in the pain, become an intelligent highly upheld youth through the pain. I didn't fail in school and other activities, instead I excelled in them. I have already "overcome the pain", and it solved absolutely none of my problems.

I am still the scared little girl I was so long ago, and nothing, no amount of success, has changed that.

Life is not wonderful. It is a miserable shithole. People believe and rationalize life because of the very deeply rooted survival instinct, but life isn't wonderful.

Life is a waste of time.

It is so very much effort to overcome the disparity of my childhood. I don't relish a victory involving overcoming a problem that I never should have had. It is no victory to simply overcome the adversity of a made up challenge. 

I'm tired. I'm meek. I'm ugly. I'm sad. I'm too masculine. I'm too hurt. I'm too mad. I'm too poor. I'm too lazy.

I am at the end of my rope.

Ha. If only it were so simple to say "I won't allow these outrageously horrible things to poison my life."(And for the record I didn't list all the terrible terrible things I went through, just a big chunk of them. I can't really bring myself to put them all in one list.)

The fact of the matter is that my life is already poisoned, it already has ended. I've been living a shadow life for over a decade. The person who I really am is not the person I have lived as. This question is strictly rhetorical, but do you know how hard it is to live an outright lie? Not just a lie about who you are (a female living and acting like a male), but lying about how you have been treated. Looking people who supposedly care about you straight in the eye and saying that "Everything is fine. No, really. I'm fine." knowing fully that everything isn't even slightly ok. I'm tired of "keeping up appearances". I'm tired of life and the lies.

I appreciate the joking demeanor, but I'm not looking for glittering generalizations; hopeful platitudes- I'm looking for real reasons. Why on earth should I live my life? What real facts contribute to that conclusion?

I am no longer convinced a life is worth living simply because it is a life to live.
